validationRules.name: VAT_Format
validationRules.message: VAT number must start with the two-letter country code.

validationRules.name: Closed_Won_Requires_Amount
validationRules.formula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( ISBLANK(Amount), Amount <= 0 ) )
validationRules.message: A won opportunity must have an Amount greater than zero.

validationRules.name: Loss_Reason_Required_When_Lost
validationRules.message: A Loss Reason is required before an opportunity can be marked Closed Lost.

validationRules.name: Active_Requires_MRR
validationRules.message: An active subscription must have an MRR greater than zero.

validationRules.name: Cancellation_Reason_Required
validationRules.message: Cancellation Reason is required when Status is Cancelled.

validationRules.name: End_Date_After_Start_Date
validationRules.message: End Date must be after Start Date.

validationRules.name: No_Reactivation_After_Cancel
validationRules.message: A cancelled subscription cannot be reactivated. Create a new subscription instead.

validationRules.name: Parent_Not_Cancelled
validationRules.message: You cannot add or change lines on a cancelled subscription.

validationRules.name: Quantity_Must_Be_Positive
validationRules.message: Quantity must be greater than zero.

validationRules.name: Budget_Required_To_Submit
validationRules.message: Add a budget before submitting the promotion.

validationRules.name: End_After_Start
validationRules.message: End Date must be on or after Start Date.
